scope: Current tracked game assets, archived source textures, all package-lock npm packages, Python QA requirements, and pinned CI action references. This is not a grant of rights to third parties in the owner’s original code, nor a clearance of repository history or the host operating system.
verificationMethod: Every texture was decoded as RGBA, fully transparent RGB bytes normalized to zero, width and height prefixed as big-endian uint32 values, and SHA-256 compared with a PNG in the creator’s official download. Retained byte hashes bind those verified pixels to the exact included files. Font bytes match pinned official Google Fonts files. Build-tool notices and registry-integrity records were inspected.
